stemMd: What is the real domain of $f(x)=\sqrt{7-x}$?
explanationMd: A real square root requires 7−x≥0. Solving this inequality gives x≤7, including the endpoint where the square root is zero.

distractorRationale.a: This reverses the inequality when isolating x.
distractorRationale.b: Values above seven make the radicand negative.
